svg.title: VP ≠ VNP F10 — The proof file by file: the 323 Lean files of vp-vnp, by library and directory, each with its declarations and its imports
svg.desc: Read from every Lean file of vp-vnp at formal-math 11b6c7e3c9: its lines, the declarations at the head of its lines, and its imports. A row is one file; a header row stands before each library and each directory, with the counts that F2's library cards and F5's directory cards give, and link to.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: The proof file by file: the 323 Lean files of vp-vnp, by library and directory, each with its declarations and its imports

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Read from every Lean file of vp-vnp at formal-math 11b6c7e3c9: its lines, the declarations at the head of its lines, and its imports. A row is one file; a header row stands before each library and each directory, with the counts that F2's library cards and F5's directory cards give, and link to.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. 323 files, 72920 lines and 4623 declarations in all. A declaration is counted where a theorem, lemma, def, structure or the like begins a line, as on F2; nothing is elaborated, so declarations made by commands or by where clauses are not counted. Each declaration links to its line in formal-math at the pin, named without its library's prefix (Nc., Paper., …) where it has one. Each file of vp-vnp in Imports and Imported by links to its row

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: here; Mathlib is named, not linked. Nc's files are grouped by the directories F5 counts, with the files at the top of Nc first. Nothing here builds or elaborates the Lean: names are read from the source text at the pinned commit, and a card says what a statement is, not that it is proved. That the proofs check is the claim of the formal-math repository's own CI (Comparator, with the nanoda kernel), not of these posters.
